The plate is a square plate about 24 cm across in the image, which spans roughly 450 px, so about 0.053 cm per px... more precisely 1 px ≈ 0.053 cm.

The pineapple pieces are about 8-9 chunks. Each is roughly 60 px by 40 px, which is about 3.2 cm by 2.1 cm, with a height of about 1.5-2 cm. That gives a volume of about 11 cm³ per chunk. For 9 chunks the total is about 100 cm³, though some chunks are smaller, so I'd put it nearer 80 cm³. At a density of about 1 g/cm³ that is roughly 80 g.
